title: feat(console): an action's confirm and param dialogs name their dismiss button (`cancelText` drawn in place of Cancel)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCvT3geLANnf5WgDVV6kTX7)_

Fixes #28879
Refs #28519

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

File surface: the card's Wanted 1-4 list (claim 6568809663), plus two mechanical consequences the seat added in amendment 6568954960 (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`, and the one `RecordDetailView` `useObjectLabel()` destructure line outside `paramCollectionHandler`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作弹出的确认框和参数框，其「取消」按钮现在显示动作自己声明的 `cancelText`；没声明时仍是「Cancel」。翻译包里的 `_actions.ACTION.cancelText` 优先，其次是作者写的多语言文本，最后是作者写的字符串。设置 → 邀请里的「Cancel Invitation」确认框，取消按钮现在写「Keep invitation」（中/日/西已翻译）。Studio 的动作表单可以填这个键，`os i18n extract` 会为带 `confirmText` 或参数的动作生成它的翻译位。
- 为什么改：`cancelText` 已在 #28859 写进 spec，但控制台一直画「Cancel」；动作本身就叫「取消……」时，两个按钮分不清哪个是保留。
- 风险与回滚：只改按钮文字，确认与取消的逻辑不变；没写 `cancelText` 的动作完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` 的 `confirmOptions`（把 `cancelText` 交给确认框）；`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts` 新增的 `cancelText` 解析；`packages/spec/liveness/action.json` 的 `cancelText` 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.confirmCancelText-28879.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionConfirmDialog.cancelText-28879.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.cancelText-28879.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The confirm path.** `ActionDef` declares `cancelText?: SpecActionInput['cancelText']` (derived) and `ACTION_DEF_KEYS` lists it. `useActionTextLocalizer` resolves it only when the action declares one: the authored `I18nLabel` is collapsed to the active language, then offered as the fallback to `useObjectLabel().actionCancelText`, so the bundle's `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.cancelText` (`globalActions.ACTION.cancelText` for an object-less action) wins. `ActionRunner#confirmOptions` hands the resolved non-empty string to the confirm handler as `options.cancelText`, which `ActionConfirmDialog` already draws over `actionConfirm.cancel`. The runner has no language, so it passes on a string only; a surface that skips the localizer keeps the host's "Cancel".

**The param path.** `ParamDialogState` gains `cancelText?: string`. Both param-collection handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime#paramCollectionHandler`, `RecordDetailView#paramCollectionHandler`) resolve it exactly as they resolve `submitText`, and `ActionParamDialog` draws it on the dismiss button, `actionDialog.cancel` when absent or empty.

**The resolver.** `@object-ui/i18n` `useObjectLabel().actionCancelText`, the sibling of `actionSubmitText` on the same `actionSuffixes` node rule (a bound action never reads `globalActions`). The member-count pin in `useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx` goes from 29 to 30.

**Types and forwarding.** `UIActionSchema.cancelText?: SpecAction['cancelText']` (amendment 6568954960). `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group` and `action:menu` forward `cancelText` to the runner; `action-forward-precedence.test.tsx` lists it after `submitText`.

**`os i18n extract`** (`pushActionCancelText`). Scaffolds `cancelText` under an action's translation root for an action that declares `confirmText` or a non-empty `params`, the population `translateAction` overlays it onto, and no slot for any other action.

**First consumer.** `sys_invitation`'s `cancel_invitation` declares `cancelText: 'Keep invitation'`. The platform-objects bundles regenerate (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`); zh-CN 保留邀请, ja-JP 招待を保持, es-ES Conservar invitación are hand-translated, as is the new Studio action-form row.

**Spec rows.** `liveness/action.json` `cancelText` flips `planned` → `live` with the read points above and drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint`; `state-counts/action.md` regenerates. The `action` / `cancelText` omit row leaves `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`, and `action.form.ts` gains a plain `cancelText` row ("Cancel button label"), not gated, because the parse refuses the key on an action that opens neither dialog. "(declared ahead of its console reader: no renderer shows it yet)" leaves the `ActionSchema.cancelText` describe and "no renderer shows it yet" leaves the translation slot's; `content/docs/references/**` regenerates. In `actions.mdx` both "The console does not draw it yet" sentences flip, the `cancelText` one and the stale `submitText` one.

## Why

`ActionSchema.cancelText` landed spec-first in #28859 with no reader, so an author who wrote it still saw "Cancel". On Setup → Invitations, **Cancel Invitation** asked with two buttons reading **Cancel** and **Cancel Invitation**.

## Tests

- `ActionRunner.confirmCancelText-28879.test.ts` (5): the bag carries `cancelText` beside the label; a label-less action still hands it on; control, no key without it; `''` hands nothing; dismissing stops the run.
- `ActionConfirmDialog.cancelText-28879.test.tsx` (3) and `ActionParamDialog.cancelText-28879.test.tsx` (4): the label is drawn, the fallback is Cancel (also for `''` on the param dialog), and the labelled button dismisses.
- `useActionTextLocalizer.cancelText-28879.test.tsx` (6): authored string, bundle first, inline map collapsed, the global node for an object-less action, nothing for an undeclared key even with a bundle entry, a nameless action's map collapsed.
- `useConsoleActionRuntime.cancelText-28879.test.tsx` (5) and `RecordDetailView.paramCancelText-28879.test.tsx` (5), one per param reader.
- `useObjectLabel-actionCancelText-28879.test.tsx` (5): the object node, the global node, no global read for a bound action (with a control), the miss answers.
- `RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431.test.tsx`: `cancelText` joins `DIALOG_READS`, and the two runtimes write the same value.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-action-cancel-text.test.ts` (7): top-level, global and inline actions; the seed-less slot; no slot without `confirmText` or `params`; bundle seed and coverage gating; one fixture through `ActionSchema` → extract → `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`.
- Sibling pins that mock `useObjectLabel` partially gain an `actionCancelText` passthrough (seven `useConsoleActionRuntime.*` files), and `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` counts the new action-form row (698 → 699).

## Acceptance notes

- Two lines outside the claim's first file surface, both added by amendment 6568954960: `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` (the renderers' `schema.cancelText` does not type-check without it), and in `RecordDetailView.tsx` the `useObjectLabel()` destructure gains `actionCancelText` (the handler cannot call the hook). Nothing else in `RecordDetailView.tsx` moves.
- `cancelText` is not interpolated: it is a button label, like `submitText`.
- Wanted 5 (inline actions) and the two skills files are out of scope, as the card says.
- `metadata-admin/MetadataTypeActions.tsx`, a third `ActionParamDialog` consumer (Setup metadata-type actions), passes neither `submitText` nor `cancelText`, so its buttons keep Confirm / Cancel. The card names the two business-action handlers only. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

Readings at head `f566aa2e` (after merging `origin/main` at `00d0668d`) unless a line says otherwise.

<details><summary>Derived gates: 112 derived, 111 run exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 112 families at `e389f7f7` (the pre-merge head; the merge brought nothing that overlaps the diff). Each ran with stdin closed and its exit captured before any pipe.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 112 accounted, 111 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, needs a whole-workspace build), left to CI.
- `check:skill-examples` and `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 on unbuilt prerequisites; after building `client-react` and the i18n-coverage closure both exit 0 (`check-i18n-coverage: OK (14 config(s), 426 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`).
- At `f566aa2e`: `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" after a spec rebuild; ui `check:new-line-citations` 0 new; `check-nul-bytes` exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- ui, at `f566aa2e`: the 18 new or touched test files plus `RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx` (the one overlap with main) → 19 files, 100 passed.
- ui, at `e389f7f7`: `packages/core/src/actions/`, `packages/i18n/`, `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, every `useActionTextLocalizer*`, `useConsoleActionRuntime*`, `ActionParamDialog*`, `ActionConfirmDialog*` and `RecordDetailView*` test → 330 files, 3779 passed, 13 skipped. `packages/types/` → 386 files, 10456 passed. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` → 169 passed, 2 skipped, exit 0 (includes `check:action-forward-parity`).
- ui type-check (turbo, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `components`, `core`, `i18n`, `react`, `types`) → 70/70 tasks, exit 0.
- spec: `vitest run src/ui/ src/system/` → 238 files, 8155 passed; `scripts/liveness/` → 12 files, 359 passed; `typecheck` exit 0.
- cli: `vitest run --project unit test/i18n-extract` → 12 files, 96 passed; `typecheck` exit 0. The integration tier is declared to CI.
- platform-objects: `test` → 108 files, 1503 passed; `typecheck` exit 0.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, committed first): deleting the `cancelText` spread in `confirmOptions` reds `ActionRunner.confirmCancelText-28879` (2 failed | 3 passed); replacing `state.cancelText || t('actionDialog.cancel')` with `t('actionDialog.cancel')` reds `ActionParamDialog.cancelText-28879` (2 failed | 2 passed). Both restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Only a describe, a form row, a liveness row and a test ledger row change there.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 section is the Chinese summary the repo asks for).
